title: Coast Guard Fifth District Air Stations Respond to Hurricane Florence
description:
B-roll of Coast Guard aviation search and rescue operations in North Carolina during the aftermath of Hurricane Florence, Sept. 16, 2018. Coast Guard aircrews participated in the rescue of 67 people and 12 pets today. During the last 72 hours, the crews participated in the rescue of a total of 133 people and 20 pets.
(U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class David Micallef, Petty Officer 1st Class Jordon Shevlin, Petty Officer 1st Class Steve Maccaferri, Petty Officer 2nd Class Dustin Williams, Air Station Atlantic City, Air Station Elizabeth City)
